$description: Sana public signed-out surfaces, measured 2026-11-19. Colours are the --color-* custom properties in the sana.ai stylesheet, checked against computed styles on https://sana.ai/ and https://sana.ai/sign-in-to-sana. The home page paints the light set. The sign-in page sets html.dark and paints the dark set. A value that was declared and not painted on a measured control says so in $extensions.source.
